items.rationale: The failed internal heating pipe is covered under 2.4.3(a), and 7.1.7(c) covers matching repair fittings. Four elbows at €9 gross each total €36.

Under 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e), these are payable only if the repaired connections required 28 mm fittings; the only replacement pipe listed is 15 mm. If their use is substantiated, five at €17 gross total €85.
Section 7.1.8(e) excludes mismatched materials, and the claim does not document a 28 mm connection in the repaired run. If that connection is substantiated, one elbow is estimated at €17 gross.
Minor fasteners used in the pipe repair are covered under 7.1.7(c), provided they are not duplicated in the consumables line under 7.1.8(c). Eight at €1 gross total €8.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers ordinary fixings needed to support the repaired run. Four clamps at €4.50 gross total €18.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like copper for the failed internal heating run, not sound pipe replaced as a precaution. At €15 gross per metre, 6.4 m totals €96.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(g) cover only technician time attributable to the pipe repair, not time spent on the other jobs. Allowing an estimated four of the 6.75 hours at €82 gross gives €328.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(g) cover necessary assistance on the pipe repair only. Allowing an estimated three of the 5.75 hours at €49 gross gives €147.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover restoration of the pre-loss rock wool insulation. At €22 gross per piece, in line with the similar insulation in Case 39, six pieces total €132.

Binding wire used to secure the replacement insulation qualifies under 7.1.7(c), but 7.1.8(e) excludes excess stock. Allow about €6 gross for the amount reasonably used, rather than pricing the full 2 kg as consumed.
Section 7.1.7(c) permits a lump sum for minor repair consumables. Allow €16 gross for repair use only, excluding separately billed items under 7.1.8(c).
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only listed charge; allow €65 gross, consistent with Case 39.

Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed pipe and insulation, but not waste from the unrelated flooring job. If the covered share is substantiated, allow €25 gross for the small volume of repair debris.
The hallway was unaffected, so 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting all 12 m². The positive figure is a placeholder, not an allowance.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude all 15 m² in the separate, undamaged storage room. The positive figure is a placeholder, not an allowance.
Section 7.1.8(a) excludes routine upkeep unrelated to the insured leak, so none of this flat charge is covered. The positive figure is a placeholder, not an allowance.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed processing and administrative charges in full. The positive figure is a placeholder, not an allowance.
